Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
January 22, 2013
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Nerice Kaufman, member of Soroptimist International of Vista
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Search and Rescue Team Presentation
P2.
Proclamation declaring 2013 as a year of celebration for the City of Vista’s Golden Anniversary
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Parking Citations Services Agreement (CC)
C4.
Gift Limit Adjustment (CC)
C5.
Law Enforcement Services Contract (CC)
C6.
Application for a Cabaret License for the California Fruit Wine Company located at 1040 La Mirada Court (CC)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
General Plan Amendment and Zone Change on E. Vista Way (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to consider an application for a General Plan Amendment and Zone Change affecting four lots on E. Vista Way;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving a General Plan Amendment from Medium High Density Residential (MHD) to Commercial Neighborhood (CN) on four lots located at 2002 through 2050 E. Vista Way; and
3.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Approving a Zone Change from Multi-Residential with a Maximum Density of 15 Units Per Acre (R-M(15)) to Commercial (C-1) on Four Lots Located at 2002 Through 2050 E. Vista Way."
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
